views.definition:
SELECT task.id,
    task.workspace_id,
    ((workspace.task_prefix || '-'::text) || lpad((task.task_number)::text, 6, '0'::text)) AS task_key,
    task.task_number,
    task.title,
    task.priority,
    task.status_id,
    task_status.name AS status_name,
    task_status.system_category AS status_category,
    task_status.color AS status_color,
    task.due_date,
    task.due_time,
    task.due_is_date_only,
    task.week_position,
    task.version,
    task.created_by,
    task.created_at,
    task.updated_at,
    primary_assignee.user_id AS primary_assignee_id,
    assignee_profile.full_name AS primary_assignee_name,
    task.due_at,
    task.type_id,
    task_type.name AS type_name,
    task.product_id,
    product.name AS product_name,
    task.event_id,
    event.name AS event_name,
    ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM task_checklist_items checklist_item
          WHERE ((checklist_item.workspace_id = task.workspace_id) AND (checklist_item.task_id = task.id))) AS checklist_total,
    ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM task_checklist_items checklist_item
          WHERE ((checklist_item.workspace_id = task.workspace_id) AND (checklist_item.task_id = task.id) AND checklist_item.is_completed)) AS checklist_completed,
    ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM task_comments task_comment
          WHERE ((task_comment.workspace_id = task.workspace_id) AND (task_comment.task_id = task.id) AND (task_comment.deleted_at IS NULL))) AS comment_count,
    NULLIF("left"(COALESCE(( SELECT string_agg((description_node.value #>> '{}'::text[]), ' '::text ORDER BY description_node.ordinality) AS string_agg
           FROM jsonb_path_query(task.description_json, 'strict $.**."text"'::jsonpath) WITH ORDINALITY description_node(value, ordinality)
          WHERE (jsonb_typeof(description_node.value) = 'string'::text)), ''::text), 240), ''::text) AS description_preview,
    task.week_lane,
    task.board_position
   FROM (((((((tasks task
     JOIN workspaces workspace ON ((workspace.id = task.workspace_id)))
     JOIN task_statuses task_status ON (((task_status.workspace_id = task.workspace_id) AND (task_status.id = task.status_id))))
     LEFT JOIN task_assignees primary_assignee ON (((primary_assignee.workspace_id = task.workspace_id) AND (primary_assignee.task_id = task.id) AND primary_assignee.is_primary)))
     LEFT JOIN profiles assignee_profile ON ((assignee_profile.id = primary_assignee.user_id)))
     LEFT JOIN task_types task_type ON (((task_type.workspace_id = task.workspace_id) AND (task_type.id = task.type_id))))
     LEFT JOIN products product ON (((product.workspace_id = task.workspace_id) AND (product.id = task.product_id))))
     LEFT JOIN events event ON (((event.workspace_id = task.workspace_id) AND (event.id = task.event_id))))
  WHERE (task.archived_at IS NULL);
